title: ImgBB Upload Request
description: Request body schema for uploading an image to ImgBB via the v1 API.

key.description: API key for authentication, obtained from https://api.imgbb.com/.

image.description: A binary file, base64-encoded image data, or a remote image URL. Maximum 32 MB.

name.description: Optional file name. Auto-detected for multipart binary uploads.

expiration.description: Auto-delete the image after this many seconds (60 to 15552000 / 180 days). Omit for permanent storage.
